recent_en: MM Computer Systems secured an AI server supply contract worth approximately RM51.58 million on 3 November 2026. Additionally, UNIRUBBER (HONG KONG) INVESTMENT CO LIMITED became a substantial shareholder on 24 September 2026. The latest financial results (period ended 30 June 2026) show revenue of RM25.976 million and net profit of RM0.32 million.
notable_en: Secured an AI server supply contract worth approximately RM51.58 million.
UNIRUBBER (HONG KONG) INVESTMENT CO LIMITED became a substantial shareholder on 24 September 2026.
earnings_en: The latest financial results (period ended 30 June 2026) show revenue of RM25.976 million, net profit of RM0.32 million, and a net margin of 1.2%.
